scope: Complete four-page original Chinese 2022 final theory question paper; Korean and English prose translations only.
source_preservation: Original native mathematics, vector diagrams and all original bitmap images/SMasks remain in the PDF with their source programs and coordinates. The six original figures are restored; no BAUPC replacement, mathematical PNG, reflow, autoshrink or new editorial text is used.

typography.source_body: Song/SimSun 10.56 pt Tr0; source Latin counterpart Times New Roman
typography.source_heading: Hei 15.96 pt; date12 pt; original Latin counterpart Calibri
typography.korean: Official Noto Serif CJK KR Regular400 for Song, Noto Sans CJK KR Regular400 for Hei. Actual source font size and baseline retained.
typography.english: Times New Roman and Calibri, matching original document Latin font families. Actual source font size and baseline retained.
typography.placement: Prose slots between native math glyphs, at original baselines. Same-line ordinary score/figure-reference/Carnot-process/X-ray language groups are explicitly listed. ASCII inter-word gaps are recorded; one English prose start has a documented +0.65pt horizontal offset within its existing slot to keep antialiasing clear of native t. No scientific glyph is moved.
typography.raster_limits: The original raster labels have no recoverable font/size/baseline metadata. Serif structure and same-document Song outline measurements infer nominal 10.15pt FEL,11.60pt diffraction and10.67pt crystal labels. Those inferences, rotations and language-only erasure boxes are recorded in raster-labels.json.

native_chinese_math.text: 离心 / 科氏 in native centrifugal/Coriolis force and torque subscripts
native_chinese_math.policy: Original physical notation retained; surrounding definitions are translated. No new explanatory notes are printed.

qa.mupdf: 4x rendering, all8 translated pages: exact native nonspace glyph metadata, fonts and original image/SMask programs identical; changed pixels outside prose, native glyph ink, bitmap ink and vector graphics all0. KO visibility loss0, new Han/NUL0.
qa.poppler: Independent Poppler26.07.0 at110dpi: all8 translated pages outside prose0 with a uniform1-raster-pixel prose-outline antialias allowance; independent native-only visible ink comparison0. Raw unexpanded outline fringe counts and original prose/math antialias mixing are separately reported, not claimed to be0.
qa.poppler_configuration_warnings: Source and proofs emit the same global display-font aliases warnings from the installed Poppler configuration. These are retained in qa-poppler.json; embedded source programs and actual rendered pages were independently inspected.
qa.visual: All four pages in both languages inspected in MuPDF and Poppler, plus original figure-language panels enlarged.
